questions.question: In 2019, how many millions of people under age 65 in the United States had no health insurance coverage?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in df.columns if pd.notna(df.iloc[3, c]) and '2019' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]
# Row index 5 corresponds to Total under 65 years in millions
result = float(df.iloc[5, col_2019])

questions.question: Among the four US geographic regions, which had the highest uninsured rate for people under age 65 in 2019?
In 2019, what was the percentage point gap in uninsured rates between males and females under age 65?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in df.columns if pd.notna(df.iloc[3, c]) and '2019' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]

male_rate = None
female_rate = None
for r in range(len(df)):
    label = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip()
    if label == 'Male':
        male_rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])
    elif label == 'Female':
        female_rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])

result = round(male_rate - female_rate, 2)

questions.question: Among Hispanic or Latino origin subgroups, what were the two with the highest uninsured rates in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in df.columns if pd.notna(df.iloc[3, c]) and '2019' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]

subgroups = ['Mexican', 'Puerto Rican', 'Cuban', 'Other Hispanic or Latino']
rates = {}
for r in range(len(df)):
    label = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip()
    if label in subgroups:
        rates[label] = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])

sorted_groups = sorted(rates.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
result = [item[0] for item in sorted_groups[:2]]

questions.question: Between 2010 and 2019, did the percentage of uninsured children under 18 years of age decrease?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2010 = [c for c in df.columns if pd.notna(df.iloc[3, c]) and '2010' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]
col_2019 = [c for c in df.columns if pd.notna(df.iloc[3, c]) and '2019' in str(df.iloc[3, c])][0]

row_idx = [r for r in range(len(df)) if str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip() == 'Under 18 years'][0]
rate_2010 = float(df.iloc[row_idx, col_2010])
rate_2019 = float(df.iloc[row_idx, col_2019])
result = 'yes' if rate_2019 < rate_2010 else 'no'

questions.question: In which survey year reported between 1984 and 2019 was the total uninsured percentage for people under 65 at its highest?
questions.program:
import re
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
header = df.iloc[3]
# Row index 7 corresponds to Total under 65 years (percent of population)
row_idx = 7

year_rates = {}
for c in range(1, len(df.columns)):
    h = str(header[c])
    if h != 'SE' and pd.notna(header[c]):
        m = re.search(r'\b(19\d\d|20\d\d)\b', h)
        if m:
            yr = m.group(1)
            val = float(df.iloc[row_idx, c])
            if yr not in year_rates or val > year_rates[yr]:
                year_rates[yr] = val

result = max(year_rates, key=year_rates.get)
